workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: The Gray pointer, pipeline and comparator all run on clk_sys; there is no crossing, so CDC-017/CDC-018/CDC-034 do not apply. The synchronous reset and inputs are contracted to clk_sys.

author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: Single-clock (clk_sys) Gray-coded event counter passed through a two-stage pipeline, decoded, and compared against a local reference count, with synchronous reset and complete I/O delays: no cross-clock crossing.
